theme_and_context.project_name: Dr. Julio Cascante - Cardiology Landing Page
theme_and_context.theme: The Humanistic Medical (Organic & Earthy meets High-Contrast Swiss)
theme_and_context.target_audience: Patients seeking premium cardiac care, prevention, and pre-surgery clearance.
theme_and_context.design_philosophy: A sophisticated, anti-template approach to medical design. Replaces sterile blues and whites with warm alabaster, deep crimson, and editorial typography to evoke trust and high-end care.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none text-foreground
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-normal tracking-tight leading-tight text-foreground
hierarchy.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-primary

rules.gradients: Do not use generic gradients. Stick to solid colors. If depth is needed, use subtle noise textures or extremely soft radial glows (max 10% opacity).
rules.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA against its background. The primary crimson (#832232) is dark enough for white text.
rules.hover_states: Hovering interactive elements should slightly darken the background or apply a subtle opacity shift (e.g., bg-primary/90).

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a very subtle SVG noise overlay across the main background to remove digital flatness (opacity 1-2%).

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding. Sections should have py-24 or py-32. Cards should have p-8 or p-10.
grids_and_layouts.services_bento_grid: Use a 3-column grid on desktop (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3). Gap: gap-6 or gap-8. Make the 'Consulta prequirúrgica' card span 2 columns if possible to create asymmetry, breaking the boring uniform grid.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align typography in most sections. Asymmetry is preferred. Use offset images (e.g., text in column 1, image shifted down in column 2).

navigation.style: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F4F3EF]/70) fixed at top, z-50.
navigation.layout: Logo left (Cormorant Garamond, text-2xl), Links center, CTA right.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-body font-medium transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95
buttons.outline: border border-primary text-primary rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-body font-medium hover:bg-primary/5 transition-colors

cards.style: bg-white border border-border/50 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-hover

whatsapp_fab.style: fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:scale-110 transition-transform flex items-center justify-center
whatsapp_fab.icon: Use WhatsApp icon from lucide-react or react-icons.

contact_form.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-[#F4F3EF]/30 rounded-none px-0 py-3 focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-primary transition-colors text-[#F4F3EF]

motion_and_interactions.scroll: MANDATORY: Implement smooth momentum scrolling using @studio-freight/react-lenis.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Use Framer Motion. The hero text must reveal line-by-line using a clipping mask (overflow-hidden on parent wrapper, y: '100%' to 0 on the text element).
motion_and_interactions.section_entrances: whileInView={ { opacity: 1, y: 0 } }, initial={ { opacity: 0, y: 40 } }, viewport={ { once: true, margin: '-100px' } }.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Very slow speed, font-heading, text-3xl or text-4xl, text-primary, separated by a mid-dot (·).

hero_portrait.description: Professional portrait of a male doctor with stethoscope. Use in Hero section.
hero_portrait.treatment: Clip/mask into an arched or pill-shaped container, or use high-end background removal. If kept as a rectangle, apply a soft shadow and rounded-3xl.

consultation.description: Doctor checking patient. Use in the Prevention Manifesto or About section.
consultation.treatment: Desaturate slightly or apply a subtle warm sepia overlay to match the earthy theme.

equipment.description: Electrocardiogram monitor. Use in the Services section (specifically for ECG or Holter).
equipment.treatment: Use inside a Bento Grid card as a visual break.

page_sections.content: Logo (Dr. Julio Cascante), Nav links (Inicio, Prevención, Servicios, Sobre Mí), CTA (Agendar Cita).

page_sections.layout: 2-column. Left: Overline ('CUIDADO CARDÍACO PREVENTIVO'), Huge H1 ('Tu corazón. / Tu vida. / Nuestra prioridad.'). Right: Hero Portrait.
page_sections.features: Line-by-line text reveal, parallax on scroll.

page_sections.layout: Editorial layout. Large numbers (01, 02). Text focusing on proactive heart care rather than reactive treatment.
Bento Grid (3 columns). Highlight 6 services: Electrocardiograma, Ecocardiograma, Consulta prequirúrgica, Ergometría, Holter, MAPA.
page_sections.features: Include minimalist icons (Phosphor or Lucide) for each service. Hover effects on cards.

page_sections.layout: Split layout. Image (consultation) on left, Text (credentials, approach) on right.
page_sections.content: Focus on experience and empathetic patient care.

page_sections.layout: Dark background container. Left: Contact info, office hours, address. Right: Contact Form (Name, Email, Message, Submit).
page_sections.features: Form should visually integrate seamlessly (minimalist borders, large typography). Send email functionality.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans-serifs for headings. Use the designated Serif font (Cormorant Garamond).
Never center-align large blocks of text. Left-alignment creates better editorial flow.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical templates (py-24, p-8, etc).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header over content that scrolls beneath it. Use glassmorphism.
Include lucide-react or react-icons for high-quality minimal icons.
Implement the WhatsApp FAB strictly as floating and distinct.
Ensure 'Consulta prequirúrgica' and other long medical terms break nicely on mobile without overflowing.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) against backgrounds.
accessibility.forms: All inputs must have associated labels or clear aria-labels.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS media queries for heavy animations.
